What do you want to do?

BackupEverything in one file: all lists, pallets, saved notes, stock, trucks, inspections, checklists. Excel: one sheet per module with every detail, easy to read, and it can be put back too. Keep it safe; put it back if something goes wrong. Photos stay in the storage bucket (the backup keeps their links).

Count it (stock taking) or change its place

Changes save when you leave a box. Pallet no puts items on a pallet: Group by pallet shows each pallet with all its items. Pallet labels makes the two labels of a pallet (every item on it, with a QR code), like Pallet label & add pallets. Scan a label at the top of this page to count the pallet or change its place. Online settings

Type the URL and the anon key of the online database to share the data with the team.

Leave it as delivery_notes. The other tables have fixed names (see below).

First time? Set up the online database (all tables, one SQL)

This ONE script makes every table the app uses, plus the photo storage. Press Copy SQL, paste it in the SQL editor of the online database and press Run. You can run it again any time (it only adds what is missing, nothing is deleted). Anyone with the key can read the data, so keep it inside the company.
